inputs.help: The inputs, the rows of the matrix, in display order, each with an id and a name. The commands and the ratings address an input by its id; it stays the same when the input is renamed.

id.help: The id of the input; value for inputId and first part of the key in scores.

name.help: The name of the input as shown in the first column.

outputs.help: The outputs, the columns of the matrix, in display order, each with an id, a name and the customer importance. The commands and the ratings address an output by its id; it stays the same when the output is renamed.

id.help: The id of the output; value for outputId and second part of the key in scores.

name.help: The name of the output as shown in the column header.

weight.help: The customer importance of the output, a whole number from 1 to 10; with it the ratings of this column go into the row sum.

scores.help: The ratings that are set, one entry per rated crossing. The key joins the id of the input and the id of the output with a colon, e.g. i1:o2. A crossing without an entry counts as 0 in the sums. A rating that is not on the scale after a change of scale stays and is marked.

scale.help: The active rating scale: 0-10 (every whole number from 0 to 10), 0-1-3-9 or 0-3-7-10. A change keeps the existing ratings.

allowedScores.help: The ratings setScore accepts on the active scale — exactly the values of the scale named in scale.

rowSums.help: The sum per input: each rating multiplied by the weight of its output and added up, in the order of inputs. The “Σ Row” column shows it; the higher, the more strongly the input acts on the weighted outputs.

paretoEdits.help: The editor settings of the Pareto chart (title, axes, threshold, bars, line); they are saved with the module.

addInput.help: Appends another input (row) to the matrix and returns its id.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

addOutput.help: Appends another output (column) with customer importance 1 to the matrix and returns its id.

params.command: An empty object; the command takes no arguments.

removeInput.help: Removes an input together with its ratings; the others stay unchanged. The last remaining input stays, the call is then rejected.

params.inputId: The id of the input. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with inputId.

removeOutput.help: Removes an output together with its ratings and its customer importance; the others stay unchanged. The last remaining output stays, the call is then rejected.

params.outputId: The id of the output. An unknown id is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with outputId.

setScore.help: Rates the crossing of an input with an output.

params.inputId: The id of the input. An unknown id is an error.
params.outputId: The id of the output. An unknown id is an error.
params.value: The rating from the active scale; null clears the rating. The scale 0-10 allows every whole number from 0 to 10, the scale 0-1-3-9 only 0, 1, 3 and 9, the scale 0-3-7-10 only 0, 3, 7 and 10. A value the active scale does not allow is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with inputId, outputId and value.

setWeight.help: Sets the customer importance of an output — the factor by which its ratings go into the row sums.

params.outputId: The id of the output. An unknown id is an error.
params.value: The customer importance, a whole number from 1 to 10. Any other value is rejected.
params.command: The command as an object with outputId and value.

setInputName.help: Names an input; id, position and ratings stay.

params.inputId: The id of the input. An unknown id is an error.
params.text: The new name of the input; an empty text clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with inputId and text.

setOutputName.help: Names an output; id, position, customer importance and ratings stay.

params.outputId: The id of the output. An unknown id is an error.
params.text: The new name of the output; an empty text clears it.
params.command: The command as an object with outputId and text.
